description: Murata GRM series multilayer ceramic chip capacitor, size 1608M (0603), 1.6 x 0.8 x 0.8 mm, class II dielectric X7R (-55 to 125 °C, ±15 %) or X5R (-55 to 85 °C, ±15 %). Parametric: capacitance, tolerance (K ±10 %, M ±20 %), rated voltage (6.3 to 50 V) and dielectric are set per placement with the exact Murata part number; the default instance is 0.1 µF ±10 % 16 V X7R (GRM188R71C104KA01D).

metadata.insulation_resistance: more than 500 Ω·F (C > 0.047 µF) at rated voltage, room temperature
metadata.source: https://search.murata.co.jp/Ceramy/image/img/A01X/G101/ENG/GRM188R71C104KA01-01.pdf (4. Rated value; Specifications and Test Methods 4, 5, 7)
metadata.voltage_proof: 250 % of rated voltage for 1 to 5 s (high dielectric constant type)

packaging_codes.D: 180 mm reel, paper tape W8P4, 4000 pcs
packaging_codes.J: 330 mm reel, paper tape W8P4, 10000 pcs

package.source: https://search.murata.co.jp/Ceramy/image/img/A01X/G101/ENG/GRM188R71C104KA01-01.pdf (3. Type & Dimensions: L 1.6 ±0.1, W 0.8 ±0.1, T 0.8 ±0.1, e 0.2 to 0.5, g 0.5 min (mm))

metadata.note: Default (X7R) instance. An X5R instance operates from -55 to 85 °C.

params.note: Two end terminations, each e 0.2 to 0.5 mm long, at least g 0.5 mm apart, on a 1.6 ±0.1 x 0.8 ±0.1 x 0.8 ±0.1 mm chip (default instance; GRM188R61A106ME69 is ±0.15, GRM188R61E106MA73 ±0.2). Flow or reflow soldering. Land pattern: the PCB tool's choice.

params.series: Murata GRM188 (GRM series, 1608M, T 0.8 mm), X5R / X7R

params.note: Default instance (X7R, DC 16 V). The rated voltage is the maximum continuously applied; with AC superimposed, the peak-to-peak or zero-to-peak voltage, whichever is larger, stays within it. An X5R instance operates from -55 to 85 °C.
source: https://search.murata.co.jp/Ceramy/image/img/A01X/G101/ENG/GRM188R71C104KA01-01.pdf (4. Rated value; Specifications and Test Methods 1)

params.note: Class II (X5R, X7R) capacitance falls with applied DC voltage, more steeply as the voltage rises, even below the rated voltage. Check the effective capacitance at the circuit's bias, and do not use these where a tight capacitance tolerance matters.
params.source: https://search.murata.co.jp/Ceramy/image/img/A01X/G101/ENG/GRM188R61E106MA73-01A.pdf (Caution 5, DC voltage and AC voltage characteristic)

params.note: Murata's general MLCCs are designed for about 10 years in use; the estimated useful life extends beyond that at 80 % of rated voltage or less and a maximum operating temperature 20 °C or more below the rated maximum.

Set the value per placement: overrides { capacitance: <F>, tolerance: 0.1 | 0.2, rated_voltage: <V>, dielectric: "X5R" | "X7R", part_number: "GRM188…" } on the board's child, naming a Murata part whose reference sheet states those values. Several high-capacitance GRM188 parts have looser dimensions (±0.15 or ±0.2 mm).

params.reason: Murata numbers neither termination and the capacitor has no polarity; two designators are needed for pin tables and footprints.
params.value: pin_1 = the -X termination, pin_2 = the +X termination

params.reason: The sheet gives e as a range; the model takes the middle, which leaves a 0.9 mm gap above the 0.5 mm minimum g. One nominal body stands for every GRM188 instance.
params.value: nominal 1.6 x 0.8 x 0.8 mm chip; each termination one block 0.35 mm long (middle of e 0.2 to 0.5) over the full width and height

params.note: Murata's reference sheets link no 3D model, and no vendor STEP was sought for a series part, whose one body stands for every value. Geometry is generated from the default sheet's dimensions (library/cad/py/catalog/murata-grm188.py).
The reference sheets state no unit mass.
